summary: I built the shared library aaa/lib/chron from the R25 code, following pipeline_decision section 10, without changing the frozen rnd/ sources. Gates G2, G3, G4, G6, G7 and G8 are fixed in the library, and each has a demo render that I looked at (2560x1440 PNGs, 100 % crops, plus mp4s for G7 and G8). I baked full MapSets of all three panels at 10 px/mm in float16: 2048 px tiles with 64 px overlap, three mips (5, 2.5, 1.25 px/mm), a manifest, and the stitch record with its needle-path order. Each panel has two sheets: <panel> (everything stitched) and <panel>_ground (the art-directed groups taken out, with their traces left in the linen: flattened protected linen, needle holes at the real strand ends, red-brown underdrawing #6E3326). Replaying the groups exactly onto the ground sheet gives back the full bake; the only differences are float16 rounding on 0 to 6 pixels out of millions, tested on all three panels. For S09, p1_oath_ground with ageing switched on is the p1' plate: goblets and stitched candles are reduced to needle-hole outlines, the 'king' group unpicks backwards in needle order (couching released first, then top to bottom) into a king-shaped void, and 'crown' is a separate group for the 15 mm R25-L lift on tethers. All four painted candle glows were removed from p1's source before segmentation. The stitched flames are now matte laid wool with cream wax. Bake time is about 3.5 to 7 min per panel at about 3.4 GB peak, so run one bake at a time. A 2560x1440 frame takes about 8 to 25 s and 1 to 1.5 GB. I iterated visually well over three times: segmentation and glows, then the ghost and needle holes, the outline web, candles, the LOD band thresholds, groups filtered by colour family, and lighting of the loose ends.
api_guide:
Full guide: aaa/lib/README.md. Use the library read-only from system python3 (3.13). Set sys.path.insert(0, '<aaa>/lib'), NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=2, cv2.setNumThreads(2), and run under nice -n 5.

MapSet (chron.maps.MapSet(MAPS+'/p1_oath')):
- Sheet coordinates are in mm from the sheet's top-left corner, x right, y down.
- Each panel sits at (20, 20) mm inside a 590.4 x 347.2 mm sheet. Source px to sheet mm: x/5+20, y/5+20.
- Outside the sheet, the same analytic linen is padded in, so a frame is never void.
- Channels: h (mm), alb (linear albedo, no lighting), T (tangent), mat (0 linen, 1 wool, 2 silk, 3 metal, ...), cov (fuzz weight), sid, reg, grp (group id, 0 = ground), birth.
- Extra layers: age_fox, age_tide, age_fade, ghost, ud, holes, gpoly, pad.
- Methods: .read(x0,y0,x1,y1, level) returns float32 working maps with PX, origin_mm and valid. Also .read_px, .full(level), .level_for(screen px/mm), .stitches().
- Group names, bboxes and centres in sheet mm are in <sheet>_ground/groups.json and groups_mm.json. Examples: p1 king centre (297.1, 206.2); crown (294.2, 124.0).

Main calls:
- chron.shade.rig(az, el, K, key_i, fill_ratio, tint, rim_i, points=[{pos_mm:(x,y,z), K, i, ref_mm, shadow}], k_env=0.35). Azimuth 135 = upper left; point z = height above the cloth in mm.
- chron.frontal.render(src, view=dict(cx_mm, cy_mm, px_per_mm), light, out_wh=(2560,1440), kmap=dict(cx_mm, cy_mm, r_mm, floor), age=0..1 | callable, edit=callable(maps), overlay=callable(img, ctx), fib='auto' | fibre dict, fib_seed). Returns dict(lin, alpha, level, ...). It picks the mip, applies the LOD fade, relights with point practicals and the metal environment term, adds halo, warps with Lanczos, then adds calibrated fibres.
- frontal.shot_fibres(src, rect_mm, level, seed): one fibre set for a whole moving shot.
- chron.grade.grade(lin, exposure, act='I'..'V', seed=frame, out_u16=False): returns sRGB.
- chron.qa.void.check_void(img, alpha): raises VoidError on any void pixel (G4).
- chron.ageing.apply_age: the same ageing used by render(age=).
- chron.anim.groupanim.GroupAnim(MapSet(MAPS+'/p1_oath_ground'), ['king']) gives exact stitch-on and unpick:
  - .edit(u, mode='unpick' | 'on', rate=entries per frame); for unpick, u = entries removed (0..n).
  - .glint_overlay(u): needle glint at the growing tip.
  - .loose_overlay(u, rate, light, linger=[(rank, phase)]): loose ends that lift, curl and pull through.
  - .state(k), .needle_tip(u), .n, .bbox.
- chron.lift.Slip(GroupAnim(G, ['crown'])): .layers(view, light, lift_mm) returns rgb, alpha and a PCSS shadow; .composite(lin, layers).
- chron.lift.tethers(img, top_mm, ground_mm, lift_mm, ctx, light, col).

Example (S09 f669):

```python
G = MapSet(MAPS + '/p1_oath_ground')
king, crown = GroupAnim(G, ['king']), GroupAnim(G, ['crown'])
candle = dict(pos_mm=(-63, 190, 78), K=1900, i=2.6, ref_mm=360, tint=0.55)
light = shade.rig(az=150, el=12, K=1900, key_i=0.3, fill_ratio=6, tint=0.5, points=[candle])
u = king.n * (f - 561) / 80
view = dict(cx_mm=310, cy_mm=170, px_per_mm=5.81)
fr = frontal.render(G, view, light, age=1.0,
                    edit=king.edit(u, mode='unpick'),
                    overlay=king.loose_overlay(u, king.n / 80, light))
L = Slip(crown).layers(view, light, 15.0)
lin = Slip(crown).composite(fr['lin'], L)
img = grade.grade(lin, exposure=1.0, act='II', seed=f)
```

Re-bake: python3 bin/bake_panel.py <panel>. The art-direction hints are in hints/<panel>.json. Re-run every demo with demo/run_all.sh. Tests are in tests/.
gates_status:
G2 metal: done. Added a warm studio-gradient environment term (softbox toward the key azimuth, 35 deg wide, 8 % dome, dark floor) and wider anisotropic metal lobes. The crown reads as couched gold at key azimuth 60, 120 and 180; g2_metal_azimuths.png shows it beside the no-environment version. Metal pixels above the L2 cap are 0.08-0.2 % of the crown crop.

G3 fuzz: done. Fuzz is weighted by coverage (fills 1, stem 0.5, cords 0.3, metal 0). There is no fibre boost on every stitch edge, so no chenille outlines. Fibre colour is the parent thread times U(0.95, 1.05). Fibres fade over dark fills, get a cheap self-shadow, and are clipped at slip edges. Before/after: g3_fuzz_compare.png.

G4 void: done. Reads beyond a sheet are padded with seamless analytic linen, every render returns a coverage alpha, and check_void raises on any void pixel. Shown with a frame straddling the sheet corner (PASS, 0 void pixels). An unpadded read of the same frame is caught (2.4 M void pixels).

G6 fill directions: done. Each region takes the structure tensor only if coherence is at least 0.35 over at least 70 % of it. Otherwise laid work gets a region-axis field with at most 12 deg bend over 30 mm; needle painting gets a blend; metal gets contour-parallel couching. Ermine is laid on a constant axis with diagonal, jittered couching. Similar-coloured regions are merged so a garment is one laid region. Whorls are gone in g6_tangent_king.png and g6_robe_ermine_compare.png.

G7 LOD: done. Shading uses the mip at 1.0-1.4x screen density. Weave and strand normals fade with screen period (fully off at 1.2 px, full at 2.7 px), lobes are Toksvig-widened, and the warp is Lanczos. On an F0 truck at 12 px/frame the registered high-frequency residual is 0.30 %, against 0.26 % for full-detail shading at four times the cost; the budget is +3 points, so it passes. I lowered the fade threshold from the pipeline's 2 px to 1.2 px because 2 px flattened the relief at F0.

G8: done.
- Stitch-on: needle-path order (laid strands back and forth across the shape, then metal, then couching bars with their tie-downs), each strand grows along its length, height pops 0.55 to 1.15 to 1.0, and a needle glint sits at the tip.
- Unpick: runs the order backwards. Loose ends lift, curl and pull through, and are lit by the strongest light including the candle. Needle holes and underdrawing show beneath.
- Snapshots plus forward replay; the replay is exact to the bake (tested).
- Ageing is a parameter (age 0 to 1): dye fade, tideline, foxing and linen yellowing, with protected linen staying fresher.

Glows: done. All four painted candle glows are removed from p1.

Not done: the void, shimmer and metal checks exist as tests and demos, but there is no farm-wide automated QA runner yet.
known_issues: Renders relight the whole frame each time (about 8-25 s at 1440p). There is no dirty-rect relight; an animated group is re-rasterised exactly inside its bounding box only.
Bakes peak at about 3.4 GB RSS, slightly above the 3 GB guideline (renders stay at 1-1.5 GB). Run only one bake at a time.

p1 king void: a few ermine and robe stitches outside the king polygon stay after the unpick, and the head part of the void has the polygon's straight sides. Refine the king polygon in hints/p1_oath.json and re-bake if the keyframe needs a cleaner silhouette.
p1 has some bare-linen windows inside garments where the segmentation called the source linen-like.
p1 faces lose some likeness at F2 (no detail-transfer zones yet).
p3: highlight strands in the navy wall read as light specks, and the night ground is busy.
p6 sky keeps the AI panel's red and violet bands. The storyboard re-dye to madder, woad-grey and buff is not baked; do it in the shot with an OKLab hue remap or apply_age.
The p3 flame groups are small (about 20 entries each), so an unpick of one flame is quick.
p6 groups: 'tower_c' leaves a bare-linen tower silhouette with needle holes when unpicked, which may need art direction. The 'banner' group polygon is approximate.

Loose ends are an authored curve model, not physics. Dark outline strands under the dim Act II key can read as dark smudges during the fastest part of an unpick (g8_unpick_seq.mp4, around frame 20). Slow the rate or lower alpha for those.
Lift (R25-L) is basic: parallax scale plus offset, PCSS shadow and 2D tethers. Tether anchor points must be chosen by the shot. The peel and anticipation curves are left to the shot scripts.
Fibres made with fib='auto' are seeded per window. Moving shots should build one set with frontal.shot_fibres and pass it as fib= so fibres do not re-seed between frames.
Toksvig widening is computed from level-0 detail averaged on the mip, which is approximate.
The magnification warning only prints; it does not stop a render beyond 1.4x.

Not implemented from pipeline section 10: the Bayeux kit, figure, crest, board, leaf and logo builders; the Blender export modules; COMP; and the farm. This stage covers the R25-F core, the animation primitives for groups, and the panel bakes.
